blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Grandview. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Grandview, South Surrey and White Rock: 66 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 5 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Grandview fell from 71 in June to 66 in September (−7.0%), and 37 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 11.0% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 600 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Grandview?
Grandview also had 146 condos and townhomes listed and 20 sold in September, against 66 houses listed. The Grandview condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Grandview?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 66 houses listed in Grandview. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Grandview a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Grandview had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Grandview from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 37 houses sold in Grandview over those 4 months, out of 240 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Grandview?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
